assumptions: Original illustrative fixed-base two-link arm; dimensions, masses, friction and controls are editable estimates, not measurements.
Rigid links use uniform-box mass properties; decorative joint and tool shapes do not add payload inertia.
Ideal hinge joints and bounded torque motors; no backlash, flexibility, thermal limits, motor electrical model or collision-avoidance controller.
Joint PD torque follows sinusoidal targets without gravity compensation; recorded poses are solver output, not commanded targets.
The browser interpolates sampled poses only. This does not establish physical fit, strength, control safety or Gyropup performance.
